memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, Decidability/RaySummary sits ABOVE the WeakCanonical/KTypeSummary root in the import graph (Compose -> SeamMulti -> Seam -> KTypeSummary root -> Saturation). Any statement mentioning listSeg (Compose.lean) cannot land in KTypeSummary/*.lean without a cycle; it lands in Compose.lean or a new RaySummary/*.lean registered in RaySummary.lean. WeakCanonical/Transfer.lean imports nothing under Decidability/, so a RaySummary file may import it freely. When a task description names a KTypeSummary landing site for a listSeg result, re-derive the import direction with grep -n '^import' before planning.
